run_undistort_scene: run undistort_scene to undistort all images in a scene using the provided config
compute_undistort_intrinsic: compute a new camera intrinsic matrix for fisheye image undistortion with centered principal point
update_camera_meta: update camera metadata dictionary with new intrinsic parameters and PINHOLE model after undistortion
undistort_precompute: precompute undistortion maps and new camera matrix for OPENCV_FISHEYE or OPENCV camera models
run_undistort_main: run the undistort script via CLI to process all scenes with locking and error handling
